analyst.summary: Dabur's Q4 FY26 (Mar-2026) showed a real but single-quarter acceleration -- domestic FMCG +9.5% on 6% volume, broad-based share gains, rural outpacing urban by 350bps -- but FY26 as a whole grew revenue only 5%, and Q1 FY27's guided double-digit growth (results due 29-Jul-2026, PENDING) is set up against a weak, rain-hit Q1 FY26 base. At ~40x trailing P/E (a discount to large-cap FMCG peers but rich in absolute terms), the stock is priced for the volume story to be confirmed, not for another base-effect quarter. No quant score exists yet; fundamentals alone support Hold, not Sell.
